header.userPrompt: Add a sample of Scala3 Union type

resultJson.title: Add Scala 3 union types sample
resultJson.body:
Adds a new sample, `src/main/scala/uniontypes/UnionTypes.scala`, showing Scala 3 union types (requested as "Add a sample of Scala3 Union type").

It covers:
- a simple `String | Int` alias matched on by type
- a closed set of result types (`User | NotFound | Forbidden`) handled with pattern matching
- an inferred union element type for a mixed `List`
- a nullable `String | Null` parameter
- commutativity of `A | B`

A `@main` method, `unionTypesDemo`, prints the examples.

The diff also includes an updated `.orca/runs/*.progress.json` file, which is run bookkeeping and not part of the sample.
